result.summary: The 429 is a real bug: name search scans an unsearchable incident list, and the client retries rate limits inside the same minute. This patch makes that error less common by returning a successful shorter list, and it leaves the retry path that spends the shared workspace budget.

problems.title: Search succeeds while dropping matches
problems.detail: Paging stops once 25 substring matches have been seen, so a common term never gets past the newest 250 incidents. The resolver reports hasNextPage false, so a missing older incident looks like a complete result.

problems.title: 429 retries still spend the same limit
problems.detail: The client retries every 429 three times, and Retry-After of 1 second does not wait out a per-minute window. Overlapping searches share one workspace token, with no cache or cancellation, so a few agents can still trip the limit.

problems.title: Tests only restate the caps
problems.detail: The new tests check that the mock is called once or three times. They do not cover 24 matches continuing, matches added across pages, or the 429 retry path.

result.betterFix: Cache the newest incident page per workspace connection and filter it in memory for each keystroke. Do not retry a 429 whose Retry-After is inside the same limit window, and if a later page fails return the matches already fetched and mark the list truncated.
